args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest notes that a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- The old name may still appear in saved reports and labels, so those need updating to Pellow Home Living.

Clarification on the rows:
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina

args.text:
@Bettina Kroll, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It is in the drafts folder and hasn't been sent.

It has Sofia's three bullets, plus your clarification: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It's signed "Bettina", so edit that if you'd rather it came from Sofia.
